messages:
ellen.rev: AxonOps wants to migrate off CompetitorX. POC asks: drop-in shim, pricing mapping (they bill by response size tiers), security questionnaire, and any response deltas that impact their ranking. Can presales/eng advise?
sam.se: I can lead. They want minimal client changes — a facade that accepts the same payloads.
vik.engineering: We can build the facade. Main technical risks: tokenizer token-count drift, differing default sampling (temp/top_p), and stop-sequence semantics. These cause output variance and billing differences.
zoe.solutions: Recommend collecting a 200-sample parity set across their core flows (intent, summarize, extract). Run A/B vs CompetitorX and Redwood standard + quantized. Measure major-regression rate and tokens per-band.
norm.security: Security checklist: SCIM/SAML SSO, BYOK (AWS/GCP KMS), IP allowlist, audit log export, and SOC2 addendum. Need their compliance contact to sign off.
sam.se: Adapter example: CompetitorX POST /v1/respond {"prompt":"...","max_out":64} -> Redwood POST /v1/completions {"model":"redwood-gen","input":"...","max_output_tokens":64}. Add output-normalizer to match stop truncation.
zoe.solutions: For billing mapping: sample responses per CompetitorX bucket, compute avg tokens, then monthly estimate = avg_tokens * per_token_rate * monthly_requests. I'll provide a small Colab for finance.
vik.engineering: Caveat: if their scoring relies on exact char offsets, tokenization differences can misalign spans. We can attempt fuzzy offset mapping in the facade but document limitations.
ellen.rev: Acceptance criteria: parity suite <=3% major regressions; P95 latency <700ms at their expected load; cost projection within 12% after sampling; security questionnaire signed.
sam.se: Timeline proposal: day 0-2 creds + security kickoff; day 3-5 build facade + smoke; day 6-8 run parity & billing samples; day 9 demo.
ellen.rev: Great. @norm.security please start the SA doc; @vik.engineering spin up proxy repo and post smoke logs here. Keeping this thread as the POC source. :thumbsup:
